diagnostics.message: The analyzer in module.secure_baseline.module.analyzer_baseline_ap-northeast-1 is created with type "ORGANIZATION" (is_organization=true), which requires the AWS Organizations organization to already exist. No attribute reference or depends_on connects this analyzer to the organization resource, so Terraform may provision the analyzer before :resource.aws_organizations_organization.org, causing an API failure or a wrong-scope analyzer. Add depends_on = [aws_organizations_organization.org] to the analyzer resource (or to the module call).
